Goal: Create a Risk Factor Model using PCA

Chosen portfolio: S&P500



```{r}
#download packages
library(tidyquant) #https://business-science.github.io/tidyquant/
library(tidyverse) #https://tidyverse.org/
library(Matrix)    #https://codeberg.org/jaganmn/Matrix
```

```{r}
#download index of s&p500
basket <- tq_index("S&P500")
```

```{r}
head(basket)
write.csv(basket, "sp500_basket.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#clean the dataframe
df <- read_csv("sp500_basket.csv")

colSums(is.na(df))
colSums(df == "" | df == " " | df == "-", na.rm = TRUE)

df_clean <- df |>
  mutate(sector = na_if(sector, ""),
         sector = na_if(sector, "-"))
df_clean$sector <- NULL

head(df_clean)
```

```{r}
#the current data set is for right now. I need historical returns from last 10 years such that I cover a full business cycle, and have enough data for PCA. get daily close price and then convert into % daily change

tickers <- df_clean |>
  mutate(symbol = str_replace_all(symbol, "\\.", "-")) |> #need to replace . with - so yfinance can read (BRK.B for ex)
  pull(symbol) |> #create vector
  unique() #make sure no duplicates

#get the data. 500 tickers is a lot. make a saved file so don't need to call yfinance everytime. use .rds bc faster than .csv and keeps data types. 
if (!file.exists("sp500_prices.rds")) 
    { 
    prices <- tq_get(tickers,
                get  = "stock.prices",
                from = Sys.Date() - years(10),
                to   = Sys.Date())
    saveRDS(prices, "sp500_prices.rds") #here we save the data. 
    } else 
        {
        historical_prices <- readRDS("sp500_prices.rds")
        }
if (!file.exists("sp500_prices.csv"))
    {
    csv_hist_price <- write_csv(historical_prices, "sp500_prices.csv") #for human readability
    }
head(csv_hist_price)
```
